body:
I remember using yopo snuff on a number of occasions. It's been awhile since that point, but I still look back with a sort of fondness.
This one time, I made some snuff. I used a minimal amount of lime.  I used the ratio of 1/4 lime to 1 whole of yopo seed. I snorted approximately a gram total. Instantly my nose burned and I had the taste of burnt peanuts in my throat. So I pinched my nostrils to prevent sneezing it all out. I waited about thirty minutes before blowing the shit out.
About ten minutes later everything veiled over in a sort of luminescent green color. Then aliens in the wall, not frightening by any means, just sort of there. I felt slightly incoherent to the situation, as though I didn't really recognize what was going on. I had to shit, so I went to the bathroom, the next thing I distinctly remember was recovering and still being on the toilet.
My friend who had done this at the same time had decided to climb a tree and apparently the experience made his nauseated and he, while sitting in this tree, vomited all over a car passing underneath. lol.
Hope this proves useful to somebody
